name: phone-br
description: Brazilian phone number input with country flag, +55 prefix, DDD area code and automatic mask

context.whenToUse: When collecting a Brazilian phone number with DDD area code
context.whenNotToUse: For international phone numbers or numbers without DDD
context.accessibility: Flag and +55 prefix are decorative, input is labeled with 'Telefone'
context.culturalNote: Brazilian phone numbers have a 2-digit DDD (area code) followed by 8 digits (landline) or 9 digits (mobile, starting with 9). Mobile numbers always start with 9 after the DDD. The +55 country code is shown but not included in the input value.
